recommendations.title: Train overlaps test
recommendations.action: 2 train rows equal a test row on (state, instructions); 326 on the state alone; 330 test rows have a near-duplicate (J≥0.8) train state, 97 of them with the same instructions and gold label. Mostly certo: 56 near items, 8 equal states, 88 near states (of 300); openjev: 16 near items, 0 equal states, 60 near states (of 300); boolq: 0 near items, 100 equal states, 107 near states (of 300); banking77: 7 near items, 0 equal states, 9 near states (of 300). Drop them in the builder (cross-source key check, near check for every source).
recommendations.effect: Removes optimistic bias of test metrics (0.9% of test rows are near-duplicate items).
recommendations.touches: data rebuild (train file hashes → data identity)

recommendations.title: hc3_fr: one label for (almost) every row
recommendations.action: 100.0% of hc3_fr's hard-target rows have gold `noul:no`. The model learns a constant, and the source's held-out metrics are meaningless. Likely an adapter bug (label mapping): fix the adapter, or drop the source until it is fixed (its weight goes to its block).
recommendations.effect: Removes a degenerate prior from its block (and from the French share).
recommendations.touches: data rebuild (or weight 0: run config identity)

recommendations.title: Template artefacts (python_repr)
recommendations.action: 1761 rows (mghafiri_scenarios 1679, decider_teacher 79, helpsteer2_correctness 2, helpsteer2_helpfulness 1). Options (criteria) rendered as Python dict reprs such as `{'level': …, 'definition': …}` or `{'value': None}`: the adapter passes structured criteria through and parse_item str()s them. Map them to text (e.g. `level: definition`) in the adapter.
recommendations.effect: Cleaner inputs; the model stops reading artefacts as features.

recommendations.title: Sources repeated > 4 epochs
recommendations.action: At 3000 steps: gen_long_refund_policy 4.4. Lower their weights or raise their caps / generate more rows (generators are cheap to regenerate).
recommendations.effect: Less memorisation of small sources; the freed share goes to sources seen < 1 epoch.
recommendations.touches: weights: run config identity only (mix.yaml); caps / generators: data rebuild

recommendations.title: Exact duplicates
recommendations.action: 1785 rows are exact duplicates of another train row (0 across sources). Dedup.
recommendations.effect: Their sources' effective epochs on the duplicated items fall; no new data.

recommendations.title: Template artefacts (nonstring_criterion)
recommendations.action: 31 rows (mghafiri_scenarios 31). Noul criteria that are dicts: parse_item keeps them unconverted and the plain layout prints their repr. Same fix as python_repr.
recommendations.effect: Cleaner inputs; the model stops reading artefacts as features.

recommendations.title: Long-bucket steps are under-filled
recommendations.action: T=2048: 21% of steps at 61% fill, T=4096: 22% of steps at 72% fill (overall fill 84%). A step is one bucket, and a long segment leaves a tail that only same-bucket segments may fill. Let short segments fill the tails of open 2048 / 4096 rows (first-fit across buckets ≥ their own), or shrink the long sources' share.
recommendations.effect: Up to 16% more segments per step at the same cost.
recommendations.touches: packer change: stream identity (pinned stream test) and slots_per_step

recommendations.title: gen_long_refund_policy dominates the token budget
recommendations.action: gen_long_refund_policy is 2.0% of the sampled segments but 16.1% of the prompt tokens (p50 2969 tokens), at 4.4 epochs.
recommendations.effect: Halving its weight frees ~half its token share for other sources; regenerating more rows lowers its epochs without changing its share.
recommendations.touches: weight: run config identity; more rows: data rebuild

recommendations.title: Rows longer than the largest bucket
recommendations.action: 75 rows exceed 4096 tokens in at least one layout; the packer drops them silently (54 draws in the simulation, 0.01%). Cap them in the builder or add a larger bucket.
recommendations.effect: No silent drop; the sampled mix matches mix.yaml.
recommendations.touches: data rebuild (or config identity for a new bucket)
